title: Kopai:  Share your expertise, and let our agents earn for you. | Product Hunt
excerpt: Kopai turns your expertise into an AI agent you can sell, priced per message instead of per hour. Upload your knowledge, publish in minutes with no code, and let people pay for instant answers instead of booking your calendar. You keep 70% of everything your agent earns. Built-in evaluation testing, encrypted knowledge bases, and multi-agent orchestration mean it's not a prompt wrapper, it's real infrastructure. We handle discovery, billing, and trust so you can focus on what you know.
